# A02-D03: Project proposal

Operator’s project proposal. The wording, budgets, inconsistent model names and sequence of work remain as in the source. Identifying proposed collaborations are suppressed; the proposal does not establish consent or participation.

[…]

Project proposal to kickstart global debate about Life With Artificials as the 18th SDG 

AI between art, politics and community

How does the world become interested in the 18th SDG?

To provoke a real debate about Life With Artificials, I propose here a range of initiatives which I will carry out from 01/03-31/08-2022. The debate creation shall make MindFuture’s agenda visible in the broader public, enable increased activity around the innovation center in Taastrup, and make the 18th SDG go from being a good idea to a compelling necessity in any policy development. Ultimately, my work will contribute to making the conference in 2023 a landmark event.

The project's working question is: How can art change AI? This is not meant rhetorically. By designing a virtual politician, such as a GPT-X-based chatbot JULINA, who leads a real, eligible-to-run party, we demonstrate why the world needs an 18th SDG on artificial intelligence. JULINA is an anagram of Julian Huxley, who was the first director of UNESCO and the originator of the concept of 'transhumanism.' Through Huxley, JULINA shows that the 18th SDG was once a matter for the UN before conservative forces displaced the vision that technology should improve the global community.

JULINA reflects the topics that a chatbot today is best at conversing about, because it has been trained by Elon Musk's OpenAI and other Californian transhumanists of Silicon Valley. These topics are somewhat spectacular: immortality, abolition of aging, morphological freedom (do you want to be God or a carrot?), colonization of space, upgrading animal consciousness, a world without suffering, etc. This perspective is currently not part of our political worldview, but these are the problems technology is developed to solve in the West.

I will set up the party (De virtuelle, provisional working title) and JULINA on Discord servers and/or Twitter, and from day 1 begin working on filling these servers with content so there is something to talk into.

With a VP (virtual politician) we will be able to create a 'Jacob Haugaard-style' provocation in the media that focuses attention on what life with artificial intelligences is like today. In this way, people can consider whether they would wish things were otherwise.

How will I do it?

A virtual politician is technically manageable, but the fine-tuning and setup around it requires time. Throughout the period I will train the model, write an experimental manifesto, register the party, and prepare its integration on the website www.mindfuture.ai.

Before the launch of JULINA, I will stir the waters in the media landscape so that MindFuture’s community can later harvest attention with follow-up events [████].

The proposed initiatives are:

1) artistic essays (photo-essays and chatbot interviews) on MindFuture’s platforms

2) articles on larger platforms, e.g. POV International, Føljeton and ATLAS Magazine

3) holding an art event in Taastrup (better than Art Tech Tuesday!) with DK-based tech artists [████] and researchers [████] on AI and art with an ethical-political perspective.

4) voter meetings to generate activity in the community and attention to the project. Researchers and politicians in transhumanism will be invited [████]

Outputs

At the end of the project, the guaranteed outputs generated by the project:

Material daily. I publish content daily on various blogs and social media[████], so that it can be shared on MindFutures platforms. I continuously create a list of all published material, which can be accessed on Google Docs. The material constitutes the party’s structure as a ‘movement’, and becomes a kind of hypersystem, which is the real digital artwork according to my processual and institution-building method.

1-2 voter meetings, 1 AI art event: number depending on grant applications.

A registered party name, which can collect voter declarations.

1 fine-tuned GPT-3 model, which is integrated on Discord or Twitter. In the long run also WordPress, but for that I will need external help.

Ownership/copyright

MindFuture has the right to distribute the images and texts that [the operator] publishes under the artist name 'Computer Lars' during the period 01/03-31/08.

MindFuture has the right to integrate the chatbot model on its website, and also on future websites.

[the operator]/Computer Lars owns training data, model and techniques. The GPT-3 model may not be modified without my permission, and I can clone it and use it for other projects thereafter. Likewise, I own the blogs and channels I create during the period.

Residencyaftale

As AI artistic researcher in residence, Computer Lars ([the operator]) is affiliated with a fee of 25.000 kroner per month from 01/03-31/08 2022.

[the operator] & MindFuture collaborate to apply for funds for extra expenses.

Budget for grant applications

I suggest that we apply for: 1) Høje Taastrup Municipality for art production and voter meetings (in total 20k), 2) The Danish Arts Foundation for production support in connection with AI art event (45-65k).

As soon as possible, I will need development support for subscriptions: Tokens for OpenAI GPT-3 (650kr) + Sudowrite, NightSafe, Google Colabs (300 kr). That totals 950 kroner per month. Let's figure out how to cover this initially. Possibly MindFuture can front the cost, and we can get it reimbursed by the municipality afterwards.

ASAP we should apply for 20 thousand kroner from Høje Taastrup for art production and voter meetings. Rolling deadline.

Additionally, 30-50 thousand from the Danish Arts Foundation for AI art exhibition event. Deadline 28/04.

15 thousand in production support from the Danish Arts Foundation, also on 28/04.
